name: xiao-s3-plus-w5500
title: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus + W5500 Ethernet Adapter
notes: XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus (ESP32-S3R8, 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM) on Seeed's XIAO W5500 Ethernet Adapter: a soldered W5500 with isolated 802.3af PoE, or USB-C power. Pins: Seeed wiki Arduino demo (SCK D8/GPIO7, MISO D9/GPIO8, MOSI D10/GPIO9, CS D1/GPIO2) and Seeed's ESPHome tutorial. INT is wired to GPIO10 only on adapter V1.2 (made after 2025-11); it's left out here so older boards work, polled: on a V1.2 board add int 10 by describing a board from this one. No RST line. The XIAO's LED on GPIO21, active low. No SD slot: zones and blocking live in RAM only.
